data.title: Zhongshan Hun
data.synopsis:
Revolving around the First Guangzhou Uprising, Sun Yat-sen's detainment in London, the Second Guangzhou Uprising and the Wuchang Uprising, this work interweaves one man's regret of causing a friend's death with the rivalries and cooperation between different revolutionary camps. These brave young people fight for the common good unto their last breath, paving this saga of toppling the millennia-old empire with their courage and blood.

(Source: IMDB)

data.title: Tokyo Babylon PVs
data.synopsis:
A full anime television series adaptation by GoHands titled Tokyo Babylon 2021 was set to premiere in 2021. However, it was canceled due to the issue of many imitation plagiarisms by GoHands. On March 29, 2021, the production committee announced that the current TV series would be canceled with a new anime production produced by a different studio.

(Source: Clamp Wiki)
